hops.name: anonymous dashboard
hops.expected: redirect to /admin/login?why=NO_COOKIE on the admin host

hops.name: login POST
hops.expected: 303 to /admin on the admin host, with a __Host- session cookie
hops.note: cookie __Host-wtp-admin set with Path, Max-Age, HttpOnly, Secure, SameSite

hops.name: dashboard with session
hops.expected: 200, the Pilot health page, no redirect

hops.name: admin API with session
hops.expected: not a 401 — the session is honoured upstream of the handler (405 is the handler's own answer to GET)

hops.name: public host with session
hops.expected: 404 on the public host regardless of the cookie

_note: No secret and no cookie value is recorded here. `location` values carry rejection classes (NO_COOKIE, EXPIRED, NOT_CONFIGURED, ...) and never anything the owner typed.
